resources.string: Reduce loud/quiet differences for low-volume listening. Gentle uses 2:1 compression; Night uses 4:1. Includes bounded makeup gain and peak protection. Changes samples; bypassed in strict passthrough.
Available while ECHO is in the foreground and no overlay or text input is active. Hold modifiers and press the key once. Seeking follows the current local or cast output.
